chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Fadhal, from Ibrahim ibn Akhi Abi Shibl, from Abi Shibl, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him)

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq)
key_terms.أَخِي أَبِي شِبْلٍ: brother of Abi Shibl (a patronymic identifier)
key_terms.أَصْحَابِنَا: our companions (referring to the Shia scholars/narrators)

ai.seo_question: What is the narrator chain for the hadith of Ali ibn al-Husayn with Yazid in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi establishes a robust chain of transmission (isnad) through prominent Kufi scholars, culminating in Imam al-Sadiq (as), to corroborate the historical encounter between Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin) and Caliph Yazid. The phrase 'similar to it' (mithluhu) signals that this report serves as a parallel testimony, reinforcing the authenticity and details of the Imam's diplomatic or political engagement with the Umayyad ruler, a key event in Shia historiography.
